Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim processing. Can you
confirm you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.
A: I was driving on the main road in Sugar Land, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. It was a weekday
afternoon and traffic was moderate.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was moving from the left lane into the right lane because I needed to make a turn at the next exit. I checked my
mirror and glanced over my shoulder, and I thought the lane was clear.
Q: What happened next?
A: The other vehicle was in my blind spot. It came alongside me and we sideswiped each other. I felt a jolt, and my
car drifted a bit before I got it under control.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not clearly. I saw something gray in the corner of my eye just as I started to move over, but I didn't process it in
time.
Q: Were you hurt?
A: Yes. My right shoulder hit the door frame and I've had pain since then. I went to urgent care that evennig and they
told me it looked like a strain, possibly a partial tear. I've been icing it and taking medication.
Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?
A: I have a follow-up with an orthopedic clinic next week. My arm still feels weak when I lift anything overhead.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?
A: Only that I'm sorry for any damage to the other car. I just want to get everything sorted out.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing with next steps.
A: Thank you.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
